about.heading: About
about.text1: Our beauty salon at Centrul pentru Antreprenori in Volintiri offers complete care: hairdressing for women and men, manicure and nail maintenance, and professional waxing. We use quality products and focus on comfort, discretion, and booking ahead. Appointments are by phone.
about.text2: Aliona Boldișor runs the studio: a qualified broad-profile hairdresser (frizer de profil larg) with professional training recognized in Moldova, including international certification. She personally handles haircuts and color, nails, and waxing so you always see the same person. She blocks enough time for each client and keeps the studio private and discreet.

certificates.title: Training & certificates
certificates.intro: Diplomas and professional certificates in hairdressing and beauty.

services.heading: Everything in one place
services.intro: Three areas of care: clear prices, no surprises.

hair.title: Hair
hair.text: Modern haircuts for women and men, with coloring using dye you bring. We work without rush in a private studio so every visit stays calm and personal.

nails.title: Nails
nails.text: Extensions, maintenance, gel strengthening, and gel polish. Quality products and careful prep for neat, lasting results.

wax.title: Waxing
wax.text: Professional waxing that is gentle on the skin and effective for comfort. We use quality products, including specialty waxes with appealing scents and colors.

gallery.heading: Our work
gallery.description: Real results from the studio: hair, nails, and waxing.

pricing.title: Transparent prices
pricing.intro: All prices in Moldovan lei (MDL). Call if you are unsure which service fits you.
pricing.note: Hair color: 100–150 MDL depending on length.

faq.title: Good to know before you visit
faq.intro: Quick answers. Call if something is not listed here.

booking.a: Call {phone} in advance. We do not take online bookings.

walkins.a: We work by appointment. Call to ask about same-day availability.

aPoints: Regularity: with each session, sensitivity may decrease.
Your individual pain threshold (it differs from person to person).
Where you are in your menstrual cycle (sensitivity can be higher at certain times).
Emotional state: fear and tension can make the sensation feel stronger.

hairColor.q: Can I bring my own hair dye?
hairColor.a: Yes. Coloring is done with your product; price depends on hair length and thickness.

privacy.a: In the studio you can feel safe: you can talk freely, laugh or cry, and be emotional — without fear of being judged. Everything discussed and that happens here stays confidential. Your comfort is the priority.

cta.title: Ready for your appointment?
cta.description: Call to book hair, nails, or waxing with Aliona. Same-day slots when available.

contact.title: Schedule by phone
contact.hours: Soft skin and personal care are a way to show care for yourself — we do it for us, not for someone else.
contact.phoneLead: Appointments are by phone only. Call Aliona to book your visit.
